title: Honey-Lemon Salmon Temaki
description: Hand rolls with lemon-honey glazed salmon, avocado and crisp lettuce.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Mix honey, lemon juice and soy sauce. Cook salmon through in a pan, then toss with the glaze and reduce briefly until lightly sticky; cool slightly and flake.
Cut each nori sheet in half. Put a small bed of sushi rice on one half of each piece; keep the other corner dry for sealing.
Add dry lettuce, avocado and salmon. Roll into a cone so the point holds the ingredients securely.
Hand rolls are best eaten immediately, before the nori loses its crispness.
notes: This recipe makes approximately eight medium hand rolls for six snack-sized servings.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
